title: Reading Drill — Planning space for folded bicycles — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Planning space for folded bicycles — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The station operations team in Brackenton received an old report about folded bicycles blocking a station side door. The report compared usable exit width, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the measurements at peak times rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered eight weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include people waiting with suitcases. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed a line of narrow bays as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
